name: Swallybog
biography:
Gullible amphibious swamp-dwellers pressed into Growlbear the Grand's service — they hunt meat for their master and scout his trap-riddled Hungering Mire, hoping not to be eaten themselves.

Gear: Blowgun, Hide Armour, Needles (6), Trident.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The swallybog can breathe air and water.

features.name: Gullible
features.description: The swallybog has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks.

features.name: Standing Leap
features.description: The swallybog's Long Jump is up to 20 feet and its High Jump is up to 10 feet with or without a running start.

features.name: Swamp Camouflage
features.description: The swallybog has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The swallybog makes two attacks, using Blowgun or Trident in any combination.

features.name: Trident
features.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

features.name: Blowgun
features.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3, range 25/100 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) Poison damage.
